title: Giraffe holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#f2b32c'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='76' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e0961e'/>
  <rect x='44' y='77' width='6' height='15' rx='3' fill='#f2b32c'/>
  <rect x='56' y='77' width='6' height='15' rx='3' fill='#e0961e'/>
  <rect x='64' y='76' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f2b32c'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <rect x='44' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a06a16'/>
  <rect x='56' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a06a16'/>
  <rect x='64' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M62 64 L70 30 L78 32 L72 66 Z' fill='#f2b32c'/>
  <!-- spots on neck -->
  <circle cx='69' cy='48' r='3' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='58' r='3' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='65' r='3' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='73' r='3' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='71' r='2.5' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='26' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f2b32c'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='28' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f7cc6a'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='71' y='14' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <rect x='78' y='14' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#c47a12'/>
  <circle cx='72.5' cy='14' r='2.5' fill='#e0961e'/>
  <circle cx='79.5' cy='14' r='2.5' fill='#e0961e'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='21' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e0961e' transform='rotate(-25 68 21)'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='24' r='1.8' fill='#3a2408'/>
  <circle cx='78.6' cy='23.4' r='0.6' fill='#fff3d0'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='27' r='0.9' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M81 30 Q84 32 87 30' stroke='#8a5a12' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart held at chest -->
  <path d='M30 46 C30 41 36 39 38 44 C40 39 46 41 46 46 C46 51 38 56 38 56 C38 56 30 51 30 46 Z' fill='#e8354e'/>
  <path d='M33 45 C33 43 35.5 42.5 36.4 44.5' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='58' y='76' width='6' height='15' rx='3' fill='#f2b32c'/>
</svg>
